content_sections.heading: DLSA Barwani Part-Time Sweeper Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will perform cleaning (साफ-सफाई) of the Mediation Centre building constructed under Tehsil Legal Services Committee Sendhwa under the terms and conditions of the Finance Department memorandum dated 06.05.2022.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment is under Madhya Pradesh Government Finance Department memo dated 06-05-2022. Appointment will not be treated as service or government service under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: How Will DLSA Barwani Select Candidates?
Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Educational certificates Identity proof Experience certificate and other documents

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DLSA Barwani Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Submit the application to Tehsil Legal Services Committee Sendhwa or District Legal Services Authority Barwani office. Submit the application by 16-11-2026 up to 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Last date was extended from 16-10-2026 to 16-11-2026. Application form asks for details of any pending criminal case.
